name: craft_loop_flow
description: The agentic craft loop: act (any registered engine command — a comfyui graph or an mcp:blender tool call) -> capture (artifacts land in the run dir) -> critique (a named image-capable model route sees the capture itself) -> decide (done, or refine with the next act command). Bounded by max_iterations (default unlimited, hard cap 1000). The three dials are the flow's declared INITIALS: through melite_flow they ride inside the tool's params (the tool spreads them onto the start body's top level, where the initial gate judges them) — agent_prompt is the brief, command is the first act (an {engine, params} object, never inputs-nested), max_iterations a JSON number.

agent_prompt.description: REQUIRED. The brief the critic holds every capture against — concrete, checkable prose (no path law: 'a 3/4 view, ../styled' is honest prose).

command.description: REQUIRED. The first act: an {engine, params} object (e.g. {"engine":"comfyui","params":{"workflow":{…}}}); NOT the {engine, comfyui, workflow} spelling — the craft gate owns this shape and refuses strangers loudly.

max_iterations.description: Optional iteration bound (default unlimited; hard cap 1000 lands LOUD). Send a JSON NUMBER — a digit-string refuses at the door.
